mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_members, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND created_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_members_this_month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_status IN ('SUSPENDED', 'INACTIVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS managed_members FROM members WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
